about_the_game:
This game offers you an immersive journey into the world of cultivation, allowing you to deeply experience a grand and mysterious realm of immortality.

The game features over 200 captivating main and side storylines, weaving a complex narrative network for players. More than 100 types of demon beast groups are scattered across various corners and secret realms of the world, which players can explore, defeat, tame, and ride. Cultivation sects and cities are spread throughout the world, awaiting players to explore, settle, and even control.

Open World Seamless Large Map

The game adopts a seamlessly connected open-world large map, enabling free exploration without the need to wait for scene loading.

A "Living" World

In this vibrant world, everything has its lifecycle. Cultivators and demon beasts exhibit different behaviors during the alternation of day and night, and all things are subject to lifespan limitations, experiencing the natural cycle of birth, aging, illness, and death. Humans and demon beasts will die when their lifespan ends, trees and spiritual plants will go through stages from seed, seedling, adulthood, to withering, and inanimate objects like houses and tables will deteriorate over time. Through cultivation, humans and demon beasts can extend their lifespan.

Independent NPCs

All NPCs make different choices based on their realm and status. From loose cultivators to sect disciples, to running shops, becoming players' companions, establishing forces, and advancing to sect leaders or city lords, NPCs' destinies are in their own hands.

Rich Skill Branch System

The game features a rich and diverse skill branch system. By comprehending different perfected branches of cultivation techniques and unique attributes, and combining them with engraving array patterns into equipment during crafting, players can create personalized combat and cultivation styles.

Sound Transmission Talisman System

The Sound Transmission Talisman allows you to interact deeply with other cultivators in this world, such as fishing together, visiting each other's homes, teaming up for adventures, and exchanging information.

Pet System

Over 100 unique demon beasts await players to capture. They are not only loyal companions on the battlefield but can also transform into mounts, accompanying you to traverse the world.

Flying System

The flying system allows players, after equipping flying magical tools, to ignore terrain restrictions and fly freely in the sky, exploring every unknown corner of this mysterious cultivation world.

Boating System

The boating system in the game allows players, after equipping boat-type magical tools, to sail freely on the water surface. Whether it's gathering in rivers or exploring and fighting in the open sea, it's all under control.

Rich Festivals and Activities

The game will regularly host various festivals and activities, such as auctions, sect competitions, pet battles, flying competitions, fishing contests, and Spring Festival celebrations. These festivals and activities will begin when the time enters the designated months.

In the game, players can experience various gameplay:

  • Explore secret realms and battle demon beasts;

  • Seek Strange Fire, refine pills and craft weapons;

  • Cultivate spiritual plants and breed demon beasts;

  • Establish sects and dominate the world;

  • Discuss Dao and dual cultivation, marry and have children;

  • Control beasts and insects, travel the world;

  • Open shops and become wealthy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i3+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Recommended 1080p, 16:9
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i3+
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 3060
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Recommended 1080p, 16:9

short_description: A 2D open-world cultivation RPG with seamless exploration. Gather resources, craft artifacts/potions, tame demonic beasts, ride mounts, fly freely, sail ships. Forge alliances, explore ecosystems/dungeons, fauna, and NPCs follow life cycles. Experience an authentic xianxia realm.
supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
